issues.message: Tool description is too short or lacks a clear sentence boundary.
Potentially destructive or side-effectful tool does not expose a confirmation, preview, or dry-run field.
Input property "path" is missing a description.

fixes.title: Clarify tool purpose and safe-use boundaries
fixes.patchHint: Expand the description with the operation scope, side effects, failure modes, and user-visible result.

fixes.title: Require confirmation or dry-run for side-effectful action
fixes.patchHint: Add a confirmation, preview, or dry_run field and describe when callers must use it before execution.

fixes.title: Describe input property "path"
fixes.patchHint: Add a concise property description that states format, constraints, examples, and whether the value is user-controlled.
